turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Mumbai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, my name is Ananya and I am calling from the fraud prevention team of your bank.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fraud team? What happened? Is something wrong?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have flagged a suspicious transaction attempt of one lakh rupees on your account. Did you authorize this payment?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh! No, no, I did not do any such thing. Oh my god.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, sir. Is it correct that you are not making any large purchases today?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Correct, I am just at home. Do you need my account number to check?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, I have your details here. For your safety, I have gone ahead and blocked your card immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you. Now what should I do? Do I need to give you some code to fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, absolutely not. Please remember that the bank will never ask you for an OTP, your PIN, or your CVV over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. I was getting very nervous. So the money is safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, the transaction was stopped. You can visit your nearest branch tomorrow to apply for a replacement card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, beta. Thank you for calling and helping me.
